purpose: Bound opportunity research without storing owner-sensitive financial, legal, health, family, welfare, creditor, or other personal facts in repository artifacts.
privacy_rules: Do not encode the underlying personal reason for a constraint in repository artifacts.
Do not place owner-sensitive facts into provider packets, public artifacts, marketing, telemetry, examples, or unrelated research outputs.
Retain only the minimum operational constraint needed for opportunity filtering.
If a future decision requires a sensitive fact, ask or verify it at the governed decision point rather than persisting it here.
